row.name: Force Weapon Throw
row.effect: Throw any one-handed melee weapon up to 10 feet. Make a Thrown Weapon skill roll to attack. The weapon returns to your hand after the attack.

levels.name: Force Weapon Throw
levels.description: The Force-user telekinetically guides a thrown weapon—typically a lightsaber—allowing it to strike targets at a distance and return to their hand.
levels.effect: Throw any one-handed melee weapon up to 10 feet. Make a Thrown Weapon skill roll to attack. The weapon returns to your hand after the attack.

levels.name: Force Weapon Throw
levels.description: The Force-user telekinetically guides a thrown weapon—typically a lightsaber—allowing it to strike targets at a distance and return to their hand.
levels.effect: Range increases to 20 feet. You gain a +1 bonus to your skill roll to hit, representing the Force guiding your aim.

levels.name: Force Weapon Throw
levels.description: The Force-user telekinetically guides a thrown weapon—typically a lightsaber—allowing it to strike targets at a distance and return to their hand.
levels.effect: Range increases to 10 yards. You may have the weapon strike a second target within 5 yards of the first before returning (make a separate attack roll at -2).

levels.name: Force Weapon Throw
levels.description: The Force-user telekinetically guides a thrown weapon—typically a lightsaber—allowing it to strike targets at a distance and return to their hand.
levels.effect: Range increases to 50 feet. You can have the weapon strike up to three targets. The second attack is at -2, the third at -4. The weapon can be guided around cover, reducing penalties by up to -4.
